store.summary: Native Superlogical Rex client: fleet inbox, Ghostty VT, Tailscale & Rime
store.description:
Rex Zero turns the M5Stack CardputerZero into a 30fps pocket mission control for Superlogical Rex across your local Zero and remote Mac/Linux machines.

Key features:
- Fleet Priority Inbox: real-time OSC 7501 Program Status events surface blocked approvals, errors, and finished agent runs across all hosts with audio chimes and instant Fn+N jump.
- Dual-Engine Workspace: read AI coding sessions (Antigravity, Codex, Claude Code) in a clean card reader with 1-key approval actions and auto-hiding per-pane drafts, or press Ctrl+T for a true libghostty-vt ANSI terminal with non-intrusive Peek vs Take-Over block sizing.
- Built-in Userspace Tailscale (tsnet) & SSH: scan an on-screen QR code to join your tailnet without root or TUN conflicts alongside existing proxies, or connect via SSH dial-stdio with zero open ports.
- Tri-Modal Input & QR Pairing: 46-key hardware typing, offline Rime Simplified/Double Pinyin (Ctrl+Space), optional streaming voice dictation (Ctrl+R), and a 5-minute LAN/Tailnet QR web pairing page to import SSH or ASR keys without typing them on device.
